boho-the-sky-caf.blurb: The Garia outlet of Boho The Sky Cafe, a rooftop cafe with a bohemian look: wooden furniture, indoor greenery and an open sky.

tips.expect: A relaxed rooftop with fusion Indian and international food and live music. About ₹1,100 for two, noon to 10:30 pm.
tips.good: The open-sky seating, nicest around sunset.
tips.watch: It is out in Garia, near Kavi Nazrul metro, not near the main pandal circuits.
tips.tip: Only worth the trip if you are already on the Jadavpur and Garia side.

boho-the-sky-cafe-madhyamgram.blurb: The Madhyamgram outlet of the Boho The Sky Cafe rooftop chain.

tips.expect: Bohemian rooftop seating with a fusion menu. About ₹1,100 for two.
tips.watch: Far north on Jessore Road, away from the pandal circuits.
tips.tip: Not a Puja-route stop. Treat it as a separate outing.

boho-the-ground-cafe.blurb: The Dum Dum / Jessore Road outlet of the Boho cafe chain.

tips.expect: The chain's bohemian look with a fusion menu.
tips.tip: Handy near Dum Dum Park and the far-north pandals.

cafe-by-the-lane-shobhabazar.blurb: The Shobhabazar outlet of Cafe By The Lane, a cafe chain with a mixed menu of momos, pastas and Thai curries.

tips.expect: A small cafe with a wide menu: momos in broth, mac and cheese, stroganoff and more.
tips.watch: I could not confirm details for this specific outlet.
tips.tip: A useful food stop beside the Shobhabazar Rajbaris.

caf-by-the-lane-lake-market.blurb: Cafe By The Lane at 7 Lake Terrace Road, off Southern Avenue.

tips.expect: A relaxed cafe with a mixed menu: momos, mac and cheese, pork platters, stroganoff and Thai curries.
tips.good: Variety, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.
tips.watch: The Lake Market area is packed on weekend evenings.
tips.tip: A calm option when the bigger Lake Road cafes are full.

cafe-by-the-lane-garia.blurb: A Patuli-side outlet of Cafe By The Lane.

tips.expect: The same easy mixed menu as the other outlets.
tips.watch: I could not confirm details for this outlet.
tips.tip: On the Garia and Patuli side, away from the main circuits.

absolute-barbecues-ruby-crossing.blurb: A live-grill buffet chain where you barbecue your own starters at the table.

tips.expect: A big buffet with an Indian, Oriental and European spread. Other Kolkata outlets are about ₹1,850 for two.
tips.good: Great for groups and families, and for hungry pandal-hoppers.
tips.watch: Buffets are heavy, so plan to eat here and then rest, not rush.
tips.tip: Book ahead on Saptami to Navami.

absolute-barbecues-salt-lake.blurb: The Sector V outlet of the Absolute Barbecues live-grill buffet chain.

tips.expect: A live grill at your table and a wide buffet. About ₹1,850 for two.
tips.good: A good pre- or post-pandal group meal near Sector V.
tips.watch: It is popular on Puja weekends.

absolute-barbecues-baguiati.blurb: The Baguiati outlet of the Absolute Barbecues buffet chain.

tips.expect: A live grill at your table. About ₹1,850 for two.
tips.good: Near the far-north pandals of Dum Dum and Lake Town.

loafer-s-cafe.blurb: A Salt Lake Sector 1 cafe with an easygoing menu, about ₹800 for two.

tips.good: A pocket-friendly stop between Salt Lake blocks.
tips.watch: Other outlets in the chain have different prices.
tips.tip: Combine with the Sector 1 pandal plan.

calcutta-bakery-cafe-saltlake.blurb: A bakery cafe at BD 97, Sector 1, Salt Lake, open noon to 11 pm daily.

tips.expect: A cosy bakery cafe. About ₹1,200 for two, with a 15% loyalty discount on return visits.
tips.watch: Seats are limited at peak times.
tips.tip: A solid dinner stop after the Salt Lake pandals.

calcutta-bakery-cafe-jadavpur.blurb: The Ganguly Bagan outlet of Calcutta Bakery Cafe, praised for its bakery items and friendly service.

tips.expect: A quaint cafe with good bakery items and desserts.
tips.good: Food quality and staff are the usual praise.
tips.watch: It is on the south side of Jadavpur, so not close to the main pandals.
tips.tip: A calm place for dessert after the Jadavpur and Naktala pandals.

cafe-mezzuna-jodhpur-park.blurb: Cafe Mezzuna at South City Mall: Italian, European and dessert menus.

tips.expect: A sit-down mall cafe, about ₹1,600 for two.
tips.good: Pasta, pizza and desserts for a mixed group.
tips.tip: Convenient for the Jadavpur 8B and Suruchi Sangha pandals.

cafe-mezzuna-elgin.blurb: The Forum Mall outlet on Elgin Road (listed as Siciliana by Mezzuna), about ₹1,200 for two.

tips.expect: An Italian and European menu in a mall setting.
tips.watch: Mall hours apply, and the name differs from the South City outlet.
tips.tip: Handy near the Bhowanipore Mallick Bari and Elgin Road.

momo-i-am-sector-v.blurb: A popular momo restaurant at Sector 5, about ₹600 for two, with Chinese, Tibetan and pan-Asian dishes.

tips.expect: A casual restaurant with buffet, live music and sports screening. Rated about 4.6.
tips.good: Momos and Tibetan and pan-Asian dishes at low prices.
tips.tip: A cheap, filling stop after the Salt Lake pandals.

momo-i-am-salt-lake.blurb: The Sector 1 outlet of the Momo I Am momo restaurant.

tips.expect: Momos and pan-Asian dishes at low prices.
tips.tip: A quick bite in the Sector 1 block pandal area.

the-10e-cafe-park-street.blurb: A pocket-friendly cafe at 10E Hungerford Street, Elgin, with mocktails, shakes and snacks.

tips.expect: A simple, cheap cafe with a long menu.
tips.tip: A budget break near Park Street and Elgin Road.

caafe-360-degree-kankurgachi.blurb: Caafe 360 Degree in Kankurgachi, a casual cafe with a wide menu, about ₹700 for two.

tips.expect: A relaxed cafe with fast food, Chinese, Italian and North Indian dishes, open 11 am to 11 pm.
tips.good: Cheap and easy for a group.
tips.tip: Handy for the Maniktala and Phoolbagan side.

caafe-360-degree-salt-lake.blurb: The Sector 3 outlet of Caafe 360 Degree, about ₹700 for two.

tips.expect: A casual cafe with a wide menu, open 11 am to 11 pm.
tips.tip: Close to FD Block and the Sector 3 pandals.
